tools.name: ScanTailor Advanced
tools.capability: Deskew, split scanned spreads, adjust margins, and dewarp pages. Strong reference for operator review of archival scans.
tools.disc_specific_gap: Page geometry; no documented physical disc/aperture pair or primary-text voting for mixed label directions.
tools.recommendation: Use alongside this tool for booklets and inserts; use this maintained fork rather than assuming the original 4lex4 fork is current.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: unpaper
tools.license: GPL-2.0-only; individual files also carry MIT, Apache-2.0, or 0BSD terms
tools.capability: Automatic page centering, deskew, and removal of scan borders and other paper artifacts.
tools.disc_specific_gap: Designed for paper; cleanup can remove legitimate label artwork. No documented annular alpha mask or projective disc model.
tools.recommendation: Useful optional document preprocessing; do not apply its cleanup indiscriminately to disc preservation images.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: NAPS2
tools.interface: C# / GUI and CLI on Windows, macOS, Linux
tools.capability: Scanner capture, image/PDF import, automatic deskew, explicit rotation, OCR, and PDF export. CLI has --deskew and --rotate.
tools.disc_specific_gap: General document workflow; no documented weak polycarbonate rim detector, aperture mask, or disc-specific perspective solver.
tools.recommendation: Good capture front end for an archivist; retain the original capture before creating our derivative.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: OCRmyPDF
tools.license: MPL-2.0 application; external dependencies have separate terms
tools.capability: Adds searchable text to scanned PDFs; supports page rotation, deskew, and archival PDF output workflows.
tools.disc_specific_gap: PDF-centered; page orientation is not semantic selection among competing disc-label directions. No disc mask geometry.
tools.recommendation: Use for accompanying manuals and booklets, not as the disc-image processing base.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: cropgui
tools.interface: Python / GTK or Tk GUI using jpegtran
tools.capability: Lossless JPEG cropping avoids another JPEG decode/re-encode cycle when the crop can align to MCU blocks.
tools.disc_specific_gap: Block-aligned rectangular crops cannot express a circular alpha knockout or arbitrary-angle perspective warp.
tools.recommendation: Useful for simple JPEG derivative crops. Canonical development moved to Codeberg; the archived GitHub mirror is not proof the whole project ceased.
tools.observed_activity: GitHub last push 2025-11-18; archived=True; Codeberg archived=False, repository updated 2026-08-29 (not a commit date)
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: pyvoussoir
tools.capability: Detects printed corner glyphs to rectify and split book photographs; exposes page size and crop offsets.
tools.disc_specific_gap: Requires capture markers and a page model. It cannot infer metric disc geometry from an unmarked ellipse alone.
tools.recommendation: Useful reference for a future calibrated capture station. Latest repository push observed: 2020; evaluate dependencies before adoption.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: Tropy
tools.capability: Organizes and describes research photographs, with metadata and an extension mechanism.
tools.disc_specific_gap: Research management rather than this automated geometric correction pipeline or a preservation repository.
tools.recommendation: Best lightweight companion for describing, grouping, and reviewing disc photographs and their derivatives.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: CropTool
tools.interface: PHP / JavaScript web application; Wikimedia OAuth
tools.capability: Crops Commons images, including lossless JPEG crops; can publish a new derivative with links to its original.
tools.disc_specific_gap: Wikimedia publication workflow, not an offline batch detector. No documented disc rim/aperture or orientation consensus.
tools.recommendation: Good provenance and derivative-linking reference for a later public archive interface. No uploads performed in this review.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: Archivematica
tools.interface: Python / web preservation system and APIs
tools.capability: Institutional digital-preservation workflows and long-term management of digital objects.
tools.disc_specific_gap: An integration destination, not a physical-rim detection or image straightening library.
tools.recommendation: Preserve original capture, accepted derivative, and our JSON logs together. An integration would need explicit metadata mapping and testing.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: Kitodo.Production
tools.license: GPL-3.0; bundled components have separate notices
tools.capability: Cultural-heritage mass digitization, workflow control, descriptive/structural metadata, and METS/MODS/ALTO ecosystem.
tools.disc_specific_gap: Large institutional workflow system rather than a drop-in disc processor.
tools.recommendation: Potential host for a processing/review step where an institution already uses Kitodo; not a reason to migrate this small CLI.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: Goobi workflow
tools.interface: Java / web digitization workflow and plugins
tools.capability: Digitization workflow management for cultural-heritage institutions; supports integration of processing activities.
tools.disc_specific_gap: Does not document this combined disc geometry, alpha, and multi-angle primary-text algorithm.
tools.recommendation: Another suitable institutional integration point; build an adapter only for an actual deployment.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: JHOVE
tools.capability: Format identification, validation, and characterization; established modules include TIFF, JPEG, JPEG 2000, and PDF.
tools.disc_specific_gap: Does not straighten images or judge physical capture accuracy. Check the specific module before assuming a format is validated.
tools.recommendation: Useful supplementary validation of supported preservation formats; our PNG/alpha tests remain necessary.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: SIPI
tools.interface: C++ / CLI and IIIF server, Linux/macOS
tools.license: AGPL-3.0 core; README also requires a licensed Kakadu source for building
tools.capability: Archival/library image delivery, format conversion, and metadata/ICC preservation or transformation.
tools.disc_specific_gap: No disc detector; JPEG 2000 build dependency means the documented stack is not entirely open source.
tools.recommendation: Relevant delivery system, not our processing base. Resolve Kakadu distribution/build terms before selecting it for an all-open stack.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: Documentarist
tools.capability: Caltech Archives project to annotate digitized documents and photographs with content information.
tools.disc_specific_gap: Repository archived; README has unfinished documentation sections. No verified production disc-correction workflow.
tools.recommendation: Catalog as historical archival prior art, not a current production starting point.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: libvips
tools.capability: Demand-driven, parallel image processing suited to large collections and memory-conscious pipelines.
tools.disc_specific_gap: No disc-specific decisions. A general resampling API does not establish equivalence to our alpha-aware EWA Lanczos3 warp.
tools.recommendation: Benchmark as an optional preview/backend candidate only when larger-volume needs justify fidelity validation; not adopted here.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: Tesseract
tools.capability: Open-source OCR and orientation/script detection; candidate for a Linux/Windows OCR backend.
tools.disc_specific_gap: Global page orientation does not identify intended primary text among artistic rotations; language models and box fidelity need testing.
tools.recommendation: Higher portability value than a Rust rewrite: evaluate behind our existing multi-view voting logic. Not substituted for Vision in this release.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: imageproc
tools.capability: Rust geometric transformations and other image operations.
tools.disc_specific_gap: Inspected warp interpolation choices are nearest, bilinear, bicubic; not a drop-in EWA Lanczos3/color-managed renderer.
tools.recommendation: Useful Rust building block, but replacing the current renderer would require a separate quality and performance project.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: opencv-rust
tools.license: MIT bindings; OpenCV license applies separately
tools.capability: Allows Rust programs to invoke OpenCV, including the same native computer-vision primitives used through Python today.
tools.disc_specific_gap: A language wrapper change does not remove repeated filtering, PNG encoding, or OCR costs.
tools.recommendation: Suitable if a broader Rust application later needs this detector; not evidence of an automatic speed improvement.
tools.evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked
